reply: For fee details, please check the latest fee structure and challan instructions on the official University of Sargodha website or contact the university accounts office.
For admission information, eligibility criteria, application deadlines and merit lists, please visit the official University of Sargodha website and check the latest admission announcements.
Class timings depend on your department, semester and section. Please check your official timetable or contact your department office.
For library services, book availability, borrowing rules and opening hours, please contact the University of Sargodha library or check its official announcements.
For hostel admission, accommodation availability, fees and rules, please contact the University of Sargodha hostel administration for current information.
